# Male bone marrow

## Loading in data

```{r}
sample_id <- "MCC8209A3_Male_BM_3"

raw_path <- file.path("/Users/costahn/Desktop/Aging Mouse Data/CITE-seq/aging_BM/per_sample_outs", sample_id,
                           "sample_raw_feature_bc_matrix")

filtered_path <- file.path("/Users/costahn/Desktop/Aging Mouse Data/CITE-seq/aging_BM/per_sample_outs", sample_id,
                           "sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix")

raw_data <- Read10X(raw_path)
filtered_data <- Read10X(filtered_path)
```

```{r}
raw_gex <- raw_data$`Gene Expression`
filtered_gex <- filtered_data$`Gene Expression`

# Explicit zero-pad instead of intersect
missing_genes <- setdiff(rownames(raw_gex), rownames(filtered_gex))
if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  pad <- Matrix::Matrix(0,
                        nrow = length(missing_genes),
                        ncol = ncol(filtered_gex),
                        sparse = TRUE,
                        dimnames = list(missing_genes, colnames(filtered_gex)))
  filtered_gex <- rbind(filtered_gex, pad)
}

filtered_gex <- filtered_gex[rownames(raw_gex), ]
stopifnot(identical(rownames(raw_gex), rownames(filtered_gex)))
```

RUnning SoupX deconamination correction

```{r}
sc <- SoupChannel(tod = raw_gex, toc = filtered_gex, channelName = sample_id)

# Quick clustering to satisfy SoupX's requirement
quick_srt <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = filtered_gex)
quick_srt <- NormalizeData(quick_srt, verbose = FALSE)
quick_srt <- FindVariableFeatures(quick_srt, verbose = FALSE)
quick_srt <- ScaleData(quick_srt, verbose = FALSE)
quick_srt <- RunPCA(quick_srt, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)
quick_srt <- FindNeighbors(quick_srt, dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
quick_srt <- FindClusters(quick_srt, resolution = 0.5, verbose = FALSE)

# Pull clusters as a named vector matching SoupChannel barcodes
clusters <- setNames(as.character(quick_srt$seurat_clusters), colnames(quick_srt))

#Set clusters and run estimation
sc <- setClusters(sc, clusters)
sc <- autoEstCont(sc)

sc$fit$rhoEst  # estimated contamination fraction
head(sc$soupProfile[order(-sc$soupProfile$est), ], 20)  # top contaminating genes

# Adjust counts
adj_counts <- adjustCounts(sc, roundToInt = TRUE)

soup_male_bm <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = adj_counts,
                                   project = sample_id)
```

```{r}
male_bm <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = filtered_gex,
                              project = sample_id)
```

Normalising the ADT data and adding the hashtags to a new assay

```{r}
library(Matrix)
library(matrixStats)

raw_adt <- raw_data$`Antibody Capture`
filtered_adt <- filtered_data$`Antibody Capture`

isotype_features <- grep("^Isotype", rownames(raw_adt), value = TRUE)
hto_features     <- grep("Hashtag",  rownames(raw_adt), value = TRUE)
adt_features     <- setdiff(rownames(raw_adt), hto_features)

stopifnot(all(isotype_features %in% rownames(raw_adt)))

cell_adt <- as.matrix(filtered_adt[adt_features, colnames(soup_male_bm)])

adt_log <- log1p(cell_adt)
isotype_vals <- as.matrix(adt_log[isotype_features, , drop = FALSE])
cell_isotype_median <- colMedians(isotype_vals)
adt_dsb <- sweep(adt_log, 2, cell_isotype_median, "-")
```

```{r}
hto_features <- c("Ms.Hashtag1", "Ms.Hashtag2","Ms.Hashtag3", "Ms.Hashtag4")

adt_all <- filtered_data$`Antibody Capture`[, colnames(male_bm)]
adt_features <- setdiff(rownames(adt_all), hto_features)

male_bm[["ADT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = adt_all[adt_features, ])
male_bm[["ADT"]]$data <- adt_dsb

male_bm[["HTO"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = filtered_data$`Antibody Capture`[hto_features,
                                                                                colnames(male_bm)])
```

```{r}
male_bm <- NormalizeData(male_bm, 
                              assay = "HTO", 
                              normalization.method = "CLR", 
                              margin = 2)

male_bm <- MULTIseqDemux(male_bm, 
                              assay = "HTO", 
                              autoThresh = TRUE)

table(male_bm$MULTI_ID)
```

```{r}
# Ensure this is character, not factor, before doing anything else
male_bm$MULTI_ID <- as.character(male_bm$MULTI_ID)

hto_to_age_male <- c(
  "Ms.Hashtag1" = "3m_M",
  "Ms.Hashtag2" = "9m_M",
  "Ms.Hashtag3" = "12m_M",
  "Ms.Hashtag4" = "18m_M"
)
male_bm$age_sex <- unname(hto_to_age_male[match(male_bm$MULTI_ID, names(hto_to_age_male))])

hto_to_age <- c(
  "Ms.Hashtag1" = "3m",
  "Ms.Hashtag2" = "9m",
  "Ms.Hashtag3" = "12m",
  "Ms.Hashtag4" = "18m"
)
male_bm$age <- unname(hto_to_age[match(male_bm$MULTI_ID, names(hto_to_age))])

rm(hto_to_age_male, hto_to_age)
```

```{r}
rm(adj_counts, adt_all, adt_dsb, adt_log, cell_adt, filtered_adt, filtered_data, 
   filtered_gex, isotype_vals, pad, quick_srt, raw_adt, raw_data, raw_gex, sc,
   adt_features, cell_isotype_median, clusters, filtered_path, missing_genes)
```

## Standard QC metrics

```{r}
# Transcriptional complexity
male_bm$log10GenesPerUMI <- log10(male_bm$nFeature_RNA) / log10(male_bm$nCount_RNA)

# Mitochondrial fraction (PercentageFeatureSet returns 0–100; convert to 0–1)
male_bm$mitoRatio <- PercentageFeatureSet(male_bm, pattern = "^mt-") / 100

# Ribosomal fraction
male_bm$riboRatio <- PercentageFeatureSet(male_bm, pattern = "^Rp[sl]") / 100

# Haemoglobin fraction — marker of ambient red blood cell RNA
hb_genes <- grep("^(Hba|Hbb)", rownames(male_bm), value = TRUE)
male_bm[["percent.hb"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(male_bm, features = hb_genes)
```

```{r}
VlnPlot(male_bm, features = "log10GenesPerUMI", group.by = "age")
VlnPlot(male_bm, features = "mitoRatio", group.by = "age")
VlnPlot(male_bm, features = "riboRatio", group.by = "age")
VlnPlot(male_bm, features = "percent.hb", group.by = "age")
```

Checking for doublets

```{r}
sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(male_bm)
sce <- scDblFinder(sce, samples = male_bm$MULTI_ID)

# Copy the doublet classification back into the Seurat metadata
male_bm$scDblFinder.class <- sce$scDblFinder.class
male_bm$scDblFinder.score <- sce$scDblFinder.score

message(sprintf(
  "%d doublets detected (%.1f%% of cells).",
  sum(male_bm$scDblFinder.class == "doublet"),
  mean(male_bm$scDblFinder.class == "doublet") * 100
))

library(dittoSeq)

dittoBarPlot(male_bm,
             var = "scDblFinder.class",
             group.by = "MULTI_ID",
             scale = "count")
```

Looking at doublet distribution

```{r}
meta <- male_bm@meta.data

ggplot(meta, aes(x = scDblFinder.score,
                         fill = scDblFinder.class)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 80, alpha = 0.8, position = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("singlet" = "#4393c3", "doublet" = "#d73027"),
                    name = "Call") +
  labs(
    title = "scDblFinder Score Distribution",
    x = "Doublet Score",
    y = "Cell Count"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
```

Filtering

```{r}
n_before <- ncol(male_bm)

male_bm_filt <- subset(
  male_bm,
  scDblFinder.class == "singlet" &
    MULTI_ID %in% c("Ms.Hashtag1", "Ms.Hashtag2", "Ms.Hashtag3", "Ms.Hashtag4") &
    log10GenesPerUMI > 0.8 &
    mitoRatio < 0.2 &
    percent.hb < 10
    
)

n_after <- ncol(male_bm_filt)
message(sprintf(
  "Cell filtering: %d → %d cells retained (%.1f%% kept).",
  n_before, n_after, n_after / n_before * 100
))
```

```{r}
male_bm <- male_bm_filt
```

Assigning cell references based on RNA

```{r}
library(celldex)
library(SingleR)
ref <- fetchReference("immgen", "2024-02-26")
sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(male_bm, assay = "RNA")

cell_identity <- SingleR(test = sce, ref = ref, labels = ref$label.main)
cell_identity2 <- SingleR(test = sce, ref = ref, labels = ref$label.fine)

male_bm$singleR_main_label <- cell_identity$pruned.labels
male_bm$singleR_fine_label <- cell_identity2$pruned.labels
male_bm$main_label_score <- cell_identity$scores

# Replace NAs (cells that couldn't be confidently labelled) with the string "NA"
# so they appear explicitly in plots and tables
male_bm$singleR_main_label[is.na(male_bm$singleR_main_label)] <- "NA"
male_bm$singleR_fine_label[is.na(male_bm$singleR_fine_label)] <- "NA"

rm(ref, sce, cell_identity, cell_identity2)

DimPlot(male_bm, reduction = "sct_umap", group.by = "singleR_main_label")
```

### Trajectory analysis

```{r}
neustem_male_bm <- readRDS("aging_male_bm_neustem.rds")
```

```{r}
library(monocle3)
library(SeuratWrappers)

find_traj_genes <- function(obj){
  orig_umap <- reducedDims(obj)$UMAP
  obj <- choose_graph_segments(obj)
  reducedDims(obj)$UMAP <- orig_umap[colnames(obj), ]
  obj <- cluster_cells(obj, reduction_method = "UMAP")
  obj <- learn_graph(obj, close_loop = FALSE, use_partition = FALSE)
  obj <- order_cells(obj, reduction_method = "UMAP")
  return(obj)
}
```

```{r}
compute_pseudotime_spearman <- function(cds) {
  
  pseudotime <- cds@principal_graph_aux@listData[["UMAP"]][["pseudotime"]]
  
  expr_matrix <- exprs(cds)  # genes x cells, sparse matrix
  expr_matrix <- expr_matrix[, names(pseudotime)]  # align cell order
  
  # Remove cells with NA/Inf pseudotime (common at root-adjacent or disconnected cells)
  valid_cells <- is.finite(pseudotime)
  expr_matrix <- expr_matrix[, valid_cells]
  pt <- pseudotime[valid_cells]
  
  # Spearman correlation per gene (loop version, safest for sparse matrices)
  spearman_results <- apply(expr_matrix, 1, function(x) {
    test <- cor.test(as.numeric(x), pt, method = "spearman")
    c(rho = test$estimate, p_value = test$p.value)
  })
  
  spearman_df <- as.data.frame(t(spearman_results))
  colnames(spearman_df) <- c("rho", "p_value")
  spearman_df$gene <- rownames(spearman_df)
  spearman_df$padj <- p.adjust(spearman_df$p_value, method = "BH")
  
  # Sort by strongest correlation
  spearman_df <- spearman_df[order(-abs(spearman_df$rho)), ]
  
  return(spearman_df)
}
```

```{r}
neustem_3m_male_bm <- subset(neustem_male_bm, age == "3m")
DimPlot(neustem_3m_male_bm, reduction = "umap", group.by = "age")

neustem_3m_male_cds <- as.cell_data_set(neustem_3m_male_bm, assay = "RNA")
neustem_3m_male_cds <- preprocess_cds(neustem_3m_male_cds, num_dim = 50)
neustem_3m_male_cds <- cluster_cells(neustem_3m_male_cds)

neustem_3m_male_cds <- learn_graph(
  neustem_3m_male_cds,
  use_partition = TRUE,
  close_loop = FALSE,
  learn_graph_control = list(
    ncenter = 300,
    prune_graph = TRUE),
  verbose = FALSE)

neustem_3m_male_cds <- order_cells(neustem_3m_male_cds, reduction_method = "UMAP")
neustem_3m_male_cds <- find_traj_genes(neustem_3m_male_cds)

neustem_3m_male_genes <- graph_test(neustem_3m_male_cds, 
                        neighbor_graph = "principal_graph", 
                        reduction_method = "UMAP", 
                        cores = 4)

neustem_3m_male_genes <- neustem_3m_male_genes[rev(order(neustem_3m_male_genes$morans_test_statistic )), ]

spearman_3m  <- compute_pseudotime_spearman(neustem_3m_male_cds)
write.csv(spearman_3m, "male_bm_3m_spearman.csv")
```

## Loading in data

```{r}
sample_id <- "MCC8209A4_Female_BM_4"

raw_path <- file.path("/Users/costahn/Desktop/Aging Mouse Data/CITE-seq/aging_BM/per_sample_outs", sample_id,
                           "sample_raw_feature_bc_matrix")

filtered_path <- file.path("/Users/costahn/Desktop/Aging Mouse Data/CITE-seq/aging_BM/per_sample_outs", sample_id,
                           "sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix")

raw_data <- Read10X(raw_path)
filtered_data <- Read10X(filtered_path)
```

```{r}
raw_gex <- raw_data$`Gene Expression`
filtered_gex <- filtered_data$`Gene Expression`

# Explicit zero-pad instead of intersect
missing_genes <- setdiff(rownames(raw_gex), rownames(filtered_gex))
if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  pad <- Matrix::Matrix(0,
                        nrow = length(missing_genes),
                        ncol = ncol(filtered_gex),
                        sparse = TRUE,
                        dimnames = list(missing_genes, colnames(filtered_gex)))
  filtered_gex <- rbind(filtered_gex, pad)
}

filtered_gex <- filtered_gex[rownames(raw_gex), ]
stopifnot(identical(rownames(raw_gex), rownames(filtered_gex)))
```

RUnning SoupX deconamination correction

```{r}
sc <- SoupChannel(tod = raw_gex, toc = filtered_gex, channelName = sample_id)

# Quick clustering to satisfy SoupX's requirement
quick_srt <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = filtered_gex)
quick_srt <- NormalizeData(quick_srt, verbose = FALSE)
quick_srt <- FindVariableFeatures(quick_srt, verbose = FALSE)
quick_srt <- ScaleData(quick_srt, verbose = FALSE)
quick_srt <- RunPCA(quick_srt, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)
quick_srt <- FindNeighbors(quick_srt, dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
quick_srt <- FindClusters(quick_srt, resolution = 0.5, verbose = FALSE)

# Pull clusters as a named vector matching SoupChannel barcodes
clusters <- setNames(as.character(quick_srt$seurat_clusters), colnames(quick_srt))

#Set clusters and run estimation
sc <- setClusters(sc, clusters)
sc <- autoEstCont(sc)

sc$fit$rhoEst  # estimated contamination fraction
head(sc$soupProfile[order(-sc$soupProfile$est), ], 20)  # top contaminating genes

# Adjust counts
adj_counts <- adjustCounts(sc, roundToInt = TRUE)

soup_female_bm <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = adj_counts,
                                   project = sample_id)
```

```{r}
female_bm <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = filtered_gex,
                              project = sample_id)
```

Normalising the ADT data and adding the hashtags to a new assay

```{r}
library(Matrix)
library(matrixStats)

raw_adt <- raw_data$`Antibody Capture`
filtered_adt <- filtered_data$`Antibody Capture`

isotype_features <- grep("^Isotype", rownames(raw_adt), value = TRUE)
hto_features     <- grep("Hashtag",  rownames(raw_adt), value = TRUE)
adt_features     <- setdiff(rownames(raw_adt), hto_features)

stopifnot(all(isotype_features %in% rownames(raw_adt)))

cell_adt <- as.matrix(filtered_adt[adt_features, colnames(soup_female_bm)])

adt_log <- log1p(cell_adt)
isotype_vals <- as.matrix(adt_log[isotype_features, , drop = FALSE])
cell_isotype_median <- colMedians(isotype_vals)
adt_dsb <- sweep(adt_log, 2, cell_isotype_median, "-")
```

```{r}
adt_features <- setdiff(rownames(adt_all), hto_features)

female_bm[["ADT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = adt_all[adt_features, ])
female_bm[["ADT"]]$data <- adt_dsb

female_bm[["HTO"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = filtered_data$`Antibody Capture`[hto_features,
                                                                                colnames(female_bm)])
```

## Standard QC metrics

```{r}
# Transcriptional complexity
female_bm$log10GenesPerUMI <- log10(female_bm$nFeature_RNA) / log10(female_bm$nCount_RNA)

# Mitochondrial fraction (PercentageFeatureSet returns 0–100; convert to 0–1)
female_bm$mitoRatio <- PercentageFeatureSet(female_bm, pattern = "^mt-") / 100

# Ribosomal fraction
female_bm$riboRatio <- PercentageFeatureSet(female_bm, pattern = "^Rp[sl]") / 100

# Haemoglobin fraction — marker of ambient red blood cell RNA
hb_genes <- grep("^(Hba|Hbb)", rownames(female_bm), value = TRUE)
female_bm[["percent.hb"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(female_bm, features = hb_genes)
```

```{r}
library(monocle3)
library(SeuratWrappers)

find_traj_genes <- function(obj){
  orig_umap <- reducedDims(obj)$UMAP
  obj <- choose_graph_segments(obj)
  reducedDims(obj)$UMAP <- orig_umap[colnames(obj), ]
  obj <- cluster_cells(obj, reduction_method = "UMAP")
  obj <- learn_graph(obj, close_loop = FALSE, use_partition = FALSE)
  obj <- order_cells(obj, reduction_method = "UMAP")
  return(obj)
}
```

```{r}
compute_pseudotime_spearman <- function(cds) {
  
  pseudotime <- cds@principal_graph_aux@listData[["UMAP"]][["pseudotime"]]
  
  expr_matrix <- exprs(cds)  # genes x cells, sparse matrix
  expr_matrix <- expr_matrix[, names(pseudotime)]  # align cell order
  
  # Remove cells with NA/Inf pseudotime (common at root-adjacent or disconnected cells)
  valid_cells <- is.finite(pseudotime)
  expr_matrix <- expr_matrix[, valid_cells]
  pt <- pseudotime[valid_cells]
  
  # Spearman correlation per gene (loop version, safest for sparse matrices)
  spearman_results <- apply(expr_matrix, 1, function(x) {
    test <- cor.test(as.numeric(x), pt, method = "spearman")
    c(rho = test$estimate, p_value = test$p.value)
  })
  
  spearman_df <- as.data.frame(t(spearman_results))
  colnames(spearman_df) <- c("rho", "p_value")
  spearman_df$gene <- rownames(spearman_df)
  spearman_df$padj <- p.adjust(spearman_df$p_value, method = "BH")
  
  # Sort by strongest correlation
  spearman_df <- spearman_df[order(-abs(spearman_df$rho)), ]
  
  return(spearman_df)
}
```

```{r}
sample_id <- "MCC8209A4_Female_BM_4"

raw_path <- file.path("/Users/costahn/Desktop/Aging Mouse Data/CITE-seq/aging_BM/per_sample_outs", sample_id,
                           "sample_raw_feature_bc_matrix")

filtered_path <- file.path("/Users/costahn/Desktop/Aging Mouse Data/CITE-seq/aging_BM/per_sample_outs", sample_id,
                           "sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix")

raw_data <- Read10X(raw_path)
filtered_data <- Read10X(filtered_path)
```

```{r}
raw_gex<- raw_data$`Gene Expression`
filtered_gex <- filtered_data$`Gene Expression`

# Explicit zero-pad instead of intersect
missing_genes <- setdiff(rownames(raw_gex), rownames(filtered_gex))
if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  pad <- Matrix::Matrix(0,
                        nrow = length(missing_genes),
                        ncol = ncol(filtered_gex),
                        sparse = TRUE,
                        dimnames = list(missing_genes, colnames(filtered_gex)))
  filtered_gex <- rbind(filtered_gex, pad)
}

filtered_gex <- filtered_gex[rownames(raw_gex), ]
stopifnot(identical(rownames(raw_gex), rownames(filtered_gex)))

sc <- SoupChannel(tod = raw_gex, toc = filtered_gex, channelName = sample_id)
```

```{r}
# Quick clustering to satisfy SoupX's requirement
quick_srt <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = filtered_gex)
quick_srt <- NormalizeData(quick_srt, verbose = FALSE)
quick_srt <- FindVariableFeatures(quick_srt, verbose = FALSE)
quick_srt <- ScaleData(quick_srt, verbose = FALSE)
quick_srt <- RunPCA(quick_srt, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)
quick_srt <- FindNeighbors(quick_srt, dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
quick_srt <- FindClusters(quick_srt, resolution = 0.5, verbose = FALSE)

# Pull clusters as a named vector matching SoupChannel barcodes
clusters <- setNames(as.character(quick_srt$seurat_clusters), colnames(quick_srt))

#Set clusters and run estimation
sc <- setClusters(sc, clusters)
sc <- autoEstCont(sc)

sc$fit$rhoEst  # estimated contamination fraction
head(sc$soupProfile[order(-sc$soupProfile$est), ], 20)  # top contaminating genes

# Adjust counts
adj_counts <- adjustCounts(sc, roundToInt = TRUE)

female_bm <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = adj_counts,
                                        project = sample_id)
```

```{r}
library(Matrix)
library(matrixStats)

raw_adt <- raw_data$`Antibody Capture`
filtered_adt <- filtered_data$`Antibody Capture`

isotype_features <- grep("^Isotype", rownames(raw_adt), value = TRUE)
hto_features     <- grep("Hashtag",  rownames(raw_adt), value = TRUE)
adt_features     <- setdiff(rownames(raw_adt), hto_features)

stopifnot(all(isotype_features %in% rownames(raw_adt)))

cell_adt <- as.matrix(filtered_adt[adt_features, colnames(soup_female_bm)])

adt_log <- log1p(cell_adt)
isotype_vals <- as.matrix(adt_log[isotype_features, , drop = FALSE])
cell_isotype_median <- colMedians(isotype_vals)
adt_dsb <- sweep(adt_log, 2, cell_isotype_median, "-")
```

```{r}
hto_features <- c("Ms.Hashtag1", "Ms.Hashtag2","Ms.Hashtag3", "Ms.Hashtag4")

adt_all <- filtered_data$`Antibody Capture`[, colnames(female_bm)]
adt_features <- setdiff(rownames(adt_all), hto_features)

soup_female_bm[["ADT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = adt_all[adt_features, ])
soup_female_bm[["ADT"]]$data <- adt_dsb

soup_female_bm[["HTO"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = filtered_data$`Antibody Capture`[hto_features,
                                                                                    colnames(female_bm)])
```

## Standard QC metrics

```{r}
# Transcriptional complexity
female_bm$log10GenesPerUMI <- log10(female_bm$nFeature_RNA) / log10(female_bm$nCount_RNA)

# Mitochondrial fraction (PercentageFeatureSet returns 0–100; convert to 0–1)
female_bm$mitoRatio <- PercentageFeatureSet(female_bm, pattern = "^mt-") / 100

# Ribosomal fraction
female_bm$riboRatio <- PercentageFeatureSet(female_bm, pattern = "^Rp[sl]") / 100

# Haemoglobin fraction — marker of ambient red blood cell RNA
hb_genes <- grep("^(Hba|Hbb)", rownames(female_bm), value = TRUE)
female_bm[["percent.hb"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(female_bm, features = hb_genes)
```

Assigning cell references based on RNA

```{r}
library(celldex)
library(SingleR)
ref <- fetchReference("immgen", "2024-02-26")
sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(female_bm, assay = "RNA")

cell_identity <- SingleR(test = sce, ref = ref, labels = ref$label.main)
cell_identity2 <- SingleR(test = sce, ref = ref, labels = ref$label.fine)

female_bm$singleR_main_label <- cell_identity$pruned.labels
female_bm$singleR_fine_label <- cell_identity2$pruned.labels
female_bm$main_label_score <- cell_identity$scores

# Replace NAs (cells that couldn't be confidently labelled) with the string "NA"
# so they appear explicitly in plots and tables
female_bm$singleR_main_label[is.na(female_bm$singleR_main_label)] <- "NA"
female_bm$singleR_fine_label[is.na(female_bm$singleR_fine_label)] <- "NA"

rm(ref, sce, cell_identity, cell_identity2)

DimPlot(female_bm, reduction = "sct_umap", group.by = "singleR_main_label")
```

```{r}
Idents(bm_merge_neutrophils) <- bm_merge_neutrophils$age_sex
bm_merge_neutrophils <- JoinLayers(bm_merge_neutrophils)

DefaultAssay(bm_merge_neutrophils) <- "RNA"

ages   <- c("3m", "12m", "18m")
assays <- c("RNA", "ADT")

degs_list <- list()

for (assay in assays) {
  DefaultAssay(bm_merge_neutrophils) <- assay
  degs_list[[assay]] <- list()
  
  for (age in ages) {
    degs <- FindMarkers(bm_merge_neutrophils,
                         ident.1 = paste0(age, "_M"),
                         ident.2 = paste0(age, "_F"),
                        min.pct = 0.05,
                        logfc.threshold = 0,
                        min.cells.feature = 3,
                        min.cells.group = 3)
  
    degs$gene <- rownames(degs)   # keep gene/ADT names as a column, not just rownames
    
    degs_list[[assay]][[age]] <- degs
    
    write.csv(degs,
              file = paste0("/Users/costahn/Desktop/Aging Mouse Data/CITE-seq/analysis/aging_bm_analysis/degs_", age, "_", assay, ".csv"),
              row.names = FALSE)
  }
}
```

```{r}
degs_3m <- degs_list[["RNA"]][["3m"]]

degs_3m_dedup <- degs_3m %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  slice_max(abs(avg_log2FC), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Split by direction (male = ident.1, so positive avg_log2FC = up in male)
sig_up_3m_male <- degs_3m_dedup %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0) %>%
  pull(gene)

sig_up_3m_female <- degs_3m_dedup %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC < 0) %>%
  pull(gene)

length(sig_up_3m_male)
length(sig_up_3m_female)

# Universe stays the same for both — all genes tested, regardless of direction
universe_genes <- degs_3m_dedup$gene

# ORA: terms enriched among genes upregulated in MALE
ego_male_3m <- enrichGO(
  gene          = sig_up_3m_male,
  universe      = universe_genes,
  OrgDb         = org.Mm.eg.db,
  keyType       = "SYMBOL",
  ont           = "BP",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.2
)

terms_3m_male <- ego_male_3m@result %>%
  dplyr::filter(pvalue < 0.05)

# ORA: terms enriched among genes upregulated in FEMALE
ego_female_3m <- enrichGO(
  gene          = sig_up_3m_female,
  universe      = universe_genes,
  OrgDb         = org.Mm.eg.db,
  keyType       = "SYMBOL",
  ont           = "BP",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.2
)

terms_3m_female <- ego_female_3m@result %>%
  dplyr::filter(pvalue < 0.05)
```

### Trajectory analysis

```{r}
library(monocle3)
library(SeuratWrappers)

find_traj_genes <- function(obj){
  orig_umap <- reducedDims(obj)$UMAP
  obj <- choose_graph_segments(obj)
  reducedDims(obj)$UMAP <- orig_umap[colnames(obj), ]
  obj <- cluster_cells(obj, reduction_method = "UMAP")
  obj <- learn_graph(obj, close_loop = FALSE, use_partition = FALSE)
  obj <- order_cells(obj, reduction_method = "UMAP")
  return(obj)
}
```

```{r}
compute_pseudotime_spearman <- function(cds) {
  
  pseudotime <- cds@principal_graph_aux@listData[["UMAP"]][["pseudotime"]]
  
  expr_matrix <- exprs(cds)  # genes x cells, sparse matrix
  expr_matrix <- expr_matrix[, names(pseudotime)]  # align cell order
  
  # Remove cells with NA/Inf pseudotime (common at root-adjacent or disconnected cells)
  valid_cells <- is.finite(pseudotime)
  expr_matrix <- expr_matrix[, valid_cells]
  pt <- pseudotime[valid_cells]
  
  # Spearman correlation per gene (loop version, safest for sparse matrices)
  spearman_results <- apply(expr_matrix, 1, function(x) {
    test <- cor.test(as.numeric(x), pt, method = "spearman")
    c(rho = test$estimate, p_value = test$p.value)
  })
  
  spearman_df <- as.data.frame(t(spearman_results))
  colnames(spearman_df) <- c("rho", "p_value")
  spearman_df$gene <- rownames(spearman_df)
  spearman_df$padj <- p.adjust(spearman_df$p_value, method = "BH")
  
  # Sort by strongest correlation
  spearman_df <- spearman_df[order(-abs(spearman_df$rho)), ]
  
  return(spearman_df)
}
```

```{r}
DimPlot(neustem_12m_male_bm, reduction = "umap", group.by = "age")

neustem_12m_male_cds <- preprocess_cds(neustem_12m_male_cds, num_dim = 50)
neustem_12m_male_cds <- cluster_cells(neustem_12m_male_cds)

neustem_12m_male_cds <- learn_graph(
  neustem_12m_male_cds,
  use_partition = FALSE,
  close_loop = FALSE,
  learn_graph_control = list(
    prune_graph = TRUE,
    minimal_branch_len = 10),
  verbose = FALSE)

neustem_12m_male_cds <- order_cells(neustem_12m_male_cds, reduction_method = "UMAP")
neustem_12m_male_cds <- find_traj_genes(neustem_12m_male_cds)

neustem_12m_male_genes <- graph_test(neustem_12m_male_cds, 
                        neighbor_graph = "principal_graph", 
                        reduction_method = "UMAP", 
                        cores = 4)

neustem_12m_male_genes <- neustem_12m_male_genes[rev(order(neustem_12m_male_genes$morans_test_statistic )), ]

spearman_12m  <- compute_pseudotime_spearman(neustem_12m_male_cds)
write.csv(spearman_12m, "male_bm_12m_spearman.csv")
```

#### Combined

```{r}
gmps_neus_all <- JoinLayers(gmps_neus_all)
combined_cds <- as.cell_data_set(gmps_neus_all, assay = "RNA")
combined_cds <- preprocess_cds(combined_cds, num_dim = 50)
combined_cds <- cluster_cells(combined_cds)

combined_cds <- learn_graph(
  combined_cds,
  use_partition = FALSE,
  close_loop = FALSE,
  learn_graph_control = list(
    prune_graph = TRUE,
    ncenter = 300),
  verbose = FALSE)

combined_cds <- order_cells(combined_cds, reduction_method = "UMAP")
```

```{r}
setwd("Aging Mouse Data/CITE-seq/analysis/aging_BM_analysis")
neustem_3m_female_genes <- read_csv("female/female_bm_3m_trajectory_moran.csv")
neustem_3m_male_genes <- read_csv("male/male_bm_3m_trajectory_moran.csv")
neustem_12m_female_genes <- read_csv("female/female_bm_12m_trajectory_moran.csv")
neustem_12m_male_genes <- read_csv("male/male_bm_12m_trajectory_moran.csv")
neustem_18m_female_genes <- read_csv("female/female_bm_18m_trajectory_moran.csv")
neustem_18m_male_genes <- read_csv("male/male_bm_18m_trajectory_moran.csv")

gene_lists <- list(
  female_3m = neustem_3m_female_genes,
  male_3m = neustem_3m_male_genes,
  female_12m = neustem_12m_female_genes,
  male_12m = neustem_12m_male_genes,
  female_18m = neustem_18m_female_genes,
  male_18m = neustem_18m_male_genes
)

sig_gene_lists <- lapply(gene_lists, function(df) {
  df %>% dplyr::filter(q_value < 0.05) %>% pull(...1)
})

all_sig_genes <- unique(unlist(sig_gene_lists))
```

```{r}
library(matrixStats)
library(ggplot2)

avg_expr <- AverageExpression(neus_all, group.by = "age_sex",
                               assays = "RNA", slot = "data")$RNA

print(colnames(avg_expr))  # confirm the exact strings before assuming anything

gene_var  <- rowVars(as.matrix(avg_expr))
top_genes <- names(sort(gene_var, decreasing = TRUE))[1:2000]
pca_input <- t(avg_expr[top_genes, ])
pca <- prcomp(pca_input, scale. = TRUE, center = TRUE)

pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:2])
pca_df$sample <- rownames(pca_df)

split_labels <- strsplit(pca_df$sample, "-")
pca_df$age <- sapply(split_labels, `[`, 1)
pca_df$sex <- sapply(split_labels, `[`, 2)

print(unique(pca_df$age))  # should now show g12m, g18m, g3m
print(unique(pca_df$sex))  # should now show F, M

pca_df$sex <- factor(pca_df$sex, levels = c("F", "M"), labels = c("female", "male"))
pca_df$age <- factor(pca_df$age, levels = c("g3m", "g12m", "g18m"))

var_explained <- round(100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2), 1)

ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = sex, group = sex)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = age), vjust = -1, size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained[1], "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained[2], "%)"),
       color = "Sex") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

```{r}
gmps_neus_all$fine_neu_labels <- factor(gmps_neus_all$fine_neu_labels, 
                                        levels = c("GMPs", "proNeu", "proNeu2", "preNeu", "immature", "mature"))

plot_pca_by_label <- function(seurat_obj, label, n_top_genes = 2000) {

  neu_subset <- subset(seurat_obj, age != "9m" & fine_neu_labels == label)

  avg_expr <- AverageExpression(neu_subset, group.by = "age_sex",
                                 assays = "RNA", slot = "data")$RNA

  # guard: need at least 3 samples for a PCA to mean anything at all,
  # and skip silently-incomplete groups rather than erroring the whole loop
  if (ncol(avg_expr) < 3) {
    message("Skipping '", label, "': only ", ncol(avg_expr), " age_sex groups present")
    return(NULL)
  }

  gene_var  <- rowVars(as.matrix(avg_expr))
  n_use     <- min(n_top_genes, sum(gene_var > 0))  # guard against too few variable genes
  top_genes <- names(sort(gene_var, decreasing = TRUE))[1:n_use]

  pca_input <- t(avg_expr[top_genes, ])
  pca <- prcomp(pca_input, scale. = TRUE, center = TRUE)

  pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:2])
  pca_df$sample <- rownames(pca_df)

  split_labels <- strsplit(pca_df$sample, "-")
  pca_df$age <- sapply(split_labels, `[`, 1)
  pca_df$sex <- sapply(split_labels, `[`, 2)

  pca_df$sex <- factor(pca_df$sex, levels = c("F", "M"), labels = c("female", "male"))
  pca_df$age <- factor(pca_df$age, levels = c("g3m", "g12m", "g18m"))

  var_explained <- round(100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2), 1)

  p <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = sex, group = sex)) +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    geom_text(aes(label = age), vjust = -1, size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(title = label,
         x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained[1], "%)"),
         y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained[2], "%)"),
         color = "Sex") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

  return(p)
}

# run across every fine_neu_labels value
all_labels <- unique(gmps_neus_all$fine_neu_labels)
pca_plots <- lapply(all_labels, function(lbl) plot_pca_by_label(gmps_neus_all, lbl))
names(pca_plots) <- all_labels
pca_plots <- Filter(Negate(is.null), pca_plots)  # drop the skipped ones

# view them
pca_plots[["proNeu"]]

# or all at once

pca_plots_ordered <- pca_plots[custom_order]
wrap_plots(pca_plots_ordered)
```

### Rho trends

```{r}
age_trend_clusters <- function(obj,
                               age_col     = "age",
                               age_levels  = c("3m", "12m", "18m"),
                               rho_cutoff  = 0.1,
                               n_clusters  = 6,
                               tol         = 0.5,   # band for high/middle/low
                               assay       = "RNA",
                               plot        = TRUE,
                               out_csv     = NULL) {

  ## --- 1. Spearman trend per gene -------------------------------------
  age_char <- as.character(obj[[age_col]][, 1])
  if (!all(age_char %in% age_levels))
    stop("ages present that are not in age_levels: ",
         paste(setdiff(unique(age_char), age_levels), collapse = ", "))

  age_numeric <- as.numeric(factor(age_char, levels = age_levels))
  expr_mat <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = assay, layer = "data")

  trend_results <- apply(expr_mat, 1, function(x) {
    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x, age_numeric, method = "spearman",
                                    exact = FALSE))
    c(rho = unname(ct$estimate), pval = ct$p.value)
  })
  trend_df <- as.data.frame(t(trend_results))
  trend_df$padj <- p.adjust(trend_df$pval, method = "BH")

  changing_genes <- trend_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(abs(rho) > rho_cutoff) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(padj)

  message(sprintf("  %d of %d genes pass |rho| > %.2f",
                  nrow(changing_genes), nrow(trend_df), rho_cutoff))

  if (nrow(changing_genes) < n_clusters) {
    warning("fewer changing genes than n_clusters -- returning trend_df only")
    return(list(trend_df = trend_df, changing_genes = changing_genes,
               gene_cluster_df = NULL))
  }

  ## --- 2. Average expression per age, z-scored ------------------------
  avg_expr <- AverageExpression(obj, group.by = age_col,
                                assays = assay, layer = "data")[[assay]]

  ## AverageExpression prefixes numeric-leading group names with "g" (e.g.
  ## "3m" -> "g3m"). Match on the trailing age string rather than assuming
  ## the prefix, so this works whether or not Seurat mangles the name.
  col_age <- sub("^g", "", colnames(avg_expr))
  age_order <- match(age_levels, col_age)
  if (any(is.na(age_order)))
    stop("could not match AverageExpression columns to age_levels; ",
         "columns were: ", paste(colnames(avg_expr), collapse = ", "))
  avg_expr <- avg_expr[, age_order, drop = FALSE]
  colnames(avg_expr) <- age_levels

  avg_expr <- avg_expr[rownames(changing_genes), , drop = FALSE]
  z_scored <- t(scale(t(avg_expr)))
  z_scored <- z_scored[complete.cases(z_scored), , drop = FALSE]  # drop zero-var rows

  ## --- 3. Hierarchical clustering --------------------------------------
  hm <- pheatmap(z_scored, cluster_cols = FALSE, cutree_rows = n_clusters,
                show_rownames = TRUE, silent = !plot)
  row_clusters <- cutree(hm$tree_row, k = n_clusters)

  ## --- 4. Name each cluster from its OWN centroid ----------------------
  name_shape <- function(v, tol) {
    lab <- ifelse(v >  tol, "high", ifelse(v < -tol, "low", "middle"))
    paste(lab, collapse = "_")
  }

  centroids <- sapply(sort(unique(row_clusters)), function(k) {
    colMeans(z_scored[row_clusters == k, age_levels, drop = FALSE])
  })
  colnames(centroids) <- sort(unique(row_clusters))
  shape_by_cluster <- apply(centroids, 2, name_shape, tol = tol)

  if (any(duplicated(shape_by_cluster)))
    warning("two clusters got the same name (", 
            paste(shape_by_cluster[duplicated(shape_by_cluster) |
                                   duplicated(shape_by_cluster, fromLast = TRUE)],
                  collapse = ", "),
            ") -- consider a smaller tol or fewer clusters")

  cluster_name <- factor(shape_by_cluster[as.character(row_clusters)],
                         levels = unique(shape_by_cluster))

  gene_cluster_df <- data.frame(
    gene            = names(row_clusters),
    cluster_number  = row_clusters,
    cluster_name    = cluster_name,
    row.names       = NULL
  )

  list(trend_df = trend_df,
       changing_genes = changing_genes,
       z_scored = z_scored,
       heatmap = hm,
       centroids = centroids,
       gene_cluster_df = gene_cluster_df)
}
```

```{r}
age_trend_clusters <- function(obj,
                               age_col     = "age",
                               age_levels  = c("3m", "12m", "18m"),
                               rho_cutoff  = 0.1,
                               n_clusters  = 6,
                               tol         = 0.5,
                               assay       = "RNA",
                               plot        = TRUE,
                               out_csv     = NULL,
                               do_cluster  = TRUE,     # NEW: FALSE = ranking only
                               min_p       = 1e-300) { # NEW: floor for pval before -log10

  suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(Seurat); library(dplyr) })

  ## --- 1. Spearman trend per gene (ALL genes) ---
  age_char <- as.character(obj[[age_col]][, 1])
  if (!all(age_char %in% age_levels))
    stop("ages present that are not in age_levels: ",
         paste(setdiff(unique(age_char), age_levels), collapse = ", "))
  age_numeric <- as.numeric(factor(age_char, levels = age_levels))
  expr_mat <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = assay, layer = "data")

  trend_results <- apply(expr_mat, 1, function(x) {
    sx <- suppressWarnings(sd(as.numeric(x)))
    if (is.na(sx) || !is.finite(sx) || sx == 0)
      return(c(rho = NA_real_, pval = NA_real_))
    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(as.numeric(x), age_numeric,
                                    method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
    c(rho = unname(ct$estimate), pval = ct$p.value)
  })
  trend_df <- as.data.frame(t(trend_results))
  trend_df$gene <- rownames(trend_df)
  trend_df$padj <- p.adjust(trend_df$pval, method = "BH")

  ## --- 2. GSEA ranking metric ---
  p_floor <- ifelse(is.na(trend_df$pval), NA_real_, pmax(trend_df$pval, min_p))
  trend_df$rank_score <- sign(trend_df$rho) * (-log10(p_floor))
  trend_df$rank_score[is.na(trend_df$rank_score)] <- 0

  ord <- order(-trend_df$rank_score,
               -ifelse(is.na(trend_df$rho), 0, trend_df$rho),
               trend_df$gene)
  trend_df$rank_order <- NA_integer_
  trend_df$rank_order[ord] <- seq_len(nrow(trend_df))

  gsea_rank <- trend_df$rank_score[ord]
  names(gsea_rank) <- trend_df$gene[ord]
  gsea_rank <- gsea_rank[!duplicated(names(gsea_rank))]
  message(sprintf(" genome-wide ranking: %d genes", length(gsea_rank)))

  ## --- 3. Filtered changing genes (for clustering) ---
  changing_genes <- trend_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(rho), abs(rho) > rho_cutoff) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(padj)
  message(sprintf(" %d of %d genes pass |rho| > %.2f",
                  nrow(changing_genes), nrow(trend_df), rho_cutoff))
  if (!is.null(out_csv)) { write.csv(trend_df, out_csv, row.names = FALSE) }

  if (!do_cluster)
    return(list(gsea_rank = gsea_rank, trend_df = trend_df,
                changing_genes = changing_genes, gene_cluster_df = NULL,
                z_scored = NULL, heatmap = NULL, centroids = NULL))

  if (nrow(changing_genes) < n_clusters) {
    warning("fewer changing genes than n_clusters -- returning ranking + trend_df only")
    return(list(gsea_rank = gsea_rank, trend_df = trend_df,
                changing_genes = changing_genes, gene_cluster_df = NULL,
                z_scored = NULL, heatmap = NULL, centroids = NULL))
  }

  ## --- 4. Average expression per age, z-scored ---
  avg_expr <- AverageExpression(obj, group.by = age_col,
                                assays = assay, layer = "data")[[assay]]
  col_age <- sub("^g", "", colnames(avg_expr))
  age_order <- match(age_levels, col_age)
  if (any(is.na(age_order)))
    stop("could not match AverageExpression columns to age_levels; columns were: ",
         paste(colnames(avg_expr), collapse = ", "))
  avg_expr <- avg_expr[, age_order, drop = FALSE]
  colnames(avg_expr) <- age_levels
  avg_expr <- avg_expr[changing_genes$gene, , drop = FALSE]
  z_scored <- t(scale(t(avg_expr)))
  z_scored <- z_scored[complete.cases(z_scored), , drop = FALSE]

  ## --- 5. Hierarchical clustering ---
  hm <- pheatmap::pheatmap(z_scored, cluster_cols = FALSE, cutree_rows = n_clusters,
                           show_rownames = TRUE, silent = !plot)
  row_clusters <- cutree(hm$tree_row, k = n_clusters)

  ## --- 6. Name each cluster from its OWN centroid ---
  name_shape <- function(v, tol) {
    lab <- ifelse(v > tol, "high", ifelse(v < -tol, "low", "middle"))
    paste(lab, collapse = "_")
  }
  centroids <- sapply(sort(unique(row_clusters)), function(k)
    colMeans(z_scored[row_clusters == k, age_levels, drop = FALSE]))
  colnames(centroids) <- sort(unique(row_clusters))
  shape_by_cluster <- apply(centroids, 2, name_shape, tol = tol)
  if (any(duplicated(shape_by_cluster)))
    warning("two clusters got the same name -- consider a smaller tol or fewer clusters")
  cluster_name <- factor(shape_by_cluster[as.character(row_clusters)],
                         levels = unique(shape_by_cluster))
  gene_cluster_df <- data.frame(gene = names(row_clusters),
                                cluster_number = row_clusters,
                                cluster_name = cluster_name, row.names = NULL)

  list(gsea_rank = gsea_rank, trend_df = trend_df,
       changing_genes = changing_genes, z_scored = z_scored,
       heatmap = hm, centroids = centroids, gene_cluster_df = gene_cluster_df)
}
```

```{r}
library(fgsea); library(msigdbr)

# one Seurat object per sex (mature neutrophils), run ranking only
res_f <- age_trend_clusters(mat_neus_female, do_cluster = FALSE)
res_m <- age_trend_clusters(mat_neus_male,   do_cluster = FALSE)

# GO:BP gene sets (mouse), restricted to the expressed background
bg <- union(names(res_f$gsea_rank), names(res_m$gsea_rank))
ms <- msigdbr(species = "mouse", db_species = "MM", collection = "M5", subcollection = "GO:BP")
pathways <- split(ms$gene_symbol, ms$gs_name)
pathways <- lapply(pathways, intersect, bg)
pathways <- pathways[lengths(pathways) >= 10 & lengths(pathways) <= 500]

set.seed(42)
fg_f <- fgsea(pathways, res_f$gsea_rank, minSize = 10, maxSize = 500)
fg_m <- fgsea(pathways, res_m$gsea_rank, minSize = 10, maxSize = 500)

write_csv(fg_f, "fg_f.csv")
write_csv(fg_m, "fg_m.csv")
```

```{r}
}, simplify = FALSE))

                          max(1, sum(out_F$res$pval < cut))
thresh <- optimise(function(c) abs(emp_fdr(c) - 0.05), c(1e-8, 0.05))$minimum
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Age and sex×age DE in mature neutrophils — cell-level NB-GLM
# ============================================================
library(Seurat); library(glmGamPoi)

set.seed(42)
NPERM  <- 50     # raise to 100+ if thresholds move between seeds
TARGET <- 0.05   # empirical FDR

# ---- 1. metadata + counts ----------------------------------
DefaultAssay(neus_all) <- "RNA"
neus_all$age <- factor(neus_all$age, levels = c("3m","12m","18m"))
neus_all$sex <- factor(neus_all$sex, levels = c("female","male"))

counts <- GetAssayData(neus_all, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
meta   <- neus_all@meta.data[, c("age","sex")]

ok     <- !is.na(meta$age) & !is.na(meta$sex)
counts <- counts[, ok]
meta   <- droplevels(meta[ok, ])
print(table(meta$sex, meta$age))          # confirm against 422/330/560/96/332/248

keep_genes <- rowSums(counts > 0) >= 10   # global filter, defined once
counts     <- counts[keep_genes, ]
cat(nrow(counts), "genes,", ncol(counts), "cells\n")

f <- meta$sex == "female"
m <- meta$sex == "male"

# ---- 2. fit helper -----------------------------------------
run_lrt <- function(cts, md, full, reduced) {
  fit <- glm_gp(cts, design = full, col_data = md,
                size_factors = "normed_sum", on_disk = FALSE)
  list(fit = fit, res = test_de(fit, reduced_design = reduced))
}

out_F   <- run_lrt(counts[, f], droplevels(meta[f, ]), ~ age, ~ 1)
out_M   <- run_lrt(counts[, m], droplevels(meta[m, ]), ~ age, ~ 1)
out_int <- run_lrt(counts, meta, ~ age * sex, ~ age + sex)

stopifnot(all(out_F$res$df1 == 2), all(out_M$res$df1 == 2),
          all(out_int$res$df1 == 2))     # all three spend 2 df

# ---- 3. permutation nulls ----------------------------------
# per-sex: shuffle age within the subset (breaks age, keeps depth structure)
# interaction: shuffle sex within age (keeps the age main effect intact)
perm_null <- function(cts, md, full, reduced, shuffle) {
  unlist(lapply(seq_len(NPERM), function(i) {
    md2 <- shuffle(md)
    run_lrt(cts, md2, full, reduced)$res$pval
  }))
}

shuf_age <- function(md) { md$age <- sample(md$age); md }
shuf_sex <- function(md) {
  md$sex <- ave(as.character(md$sex), md$age, FUN = sample)
  md$sex <- factor(md$sex, levels = levels(meta$sex)); md
}

null_F   <- perm_null(counts[, f], droplevels(meta[f, ]), ~ age, ~ 1, shuf_age)
null_M   <- perm_null(counts[, m], droplevels(meta[m, ]), ~ age, ~ 1, shuf_age)
null_int <- perm_null(counts, meta, ~ age * sex, ~ age + sex, shuf_sex)

# ---- 4. empirical-FDR threshold ----------------------------
calib <- function(obs_p, null_p, target = TARGET) {
  grid <- 10^seq(-8, log10(0.05), length.out = 200)
  fdr  <- sapply(grid, function(c)
            (mean(null_p < c) * length(obs_p)) / max(1, sum(obs_p < c)))
  ok   <- which(fdr <= target)
  if (!length(ok)) return(list(thresh = 0, fdr = NA_real_))
  i <- max(ok); list(thresh = grid[i], fdr = fdr[i])
}

cal_F   <- calib(out_F$res$pval,   null_F)
cal_M   <- calib(out_M$res$pval,   null_M)
cal_int <- calib(out_int$res$pval, null_int)

# ---- 5. fitted means, z-scored (same axis as your patterns) --
group_means <- function(fit) {
  B <- fit$Beta
  cbind(`3m` = B[,1], `12m` = B[,1] + B[,2], `18m` = B[,1] + B[,3])
}
z_F <- t(scale(t(group_means(out_F$fit))))
z_M <- t(scale(t(group_means(out_M$fit))))

# ---- 6. tables ---------------------------------------------
build <- function(out, cal, z = NULL) {
  tb <- out$res[out$res$pval < cal$thresh, c("name","pval","adj_pval","f_statistic")]
  tb <- tb[order(tb$pval), ]
  if (!is.null(z)) tb <- cbind(tb, z[match(tb$name, rownames(z)), , drop = FALSE])
  tb
}
tab_F   <- build(out_F,   cal_F,   z_F)
tab_M   <- build(out_M,   cal_M,   z_M)
tab_int <- build(out_int, cal_int)

genes_F <- tab_F$name; genes_M <- tab_M$name; genes_int <- tab_int$name

# ---- 7. sensitivity: interaction without the 96-cell 12m male group
sub <- meta$age != "12m"
out_int_no12 <- run_lrt(counts[, sub], droplevels(meta[sub, ]),
                        ~ age * sex, ~ age + sex)
robust_int <- intersect(genes_int,
                        out_int_no12$res$name[out_int_no12$res$pval < 0.05])

# ---- 8. report ---------------------------------------------
cat(sprintf("female : thresh %.2e -> %d genes (BH<0.05: %d)\n",
            cal_F$thresh, length(genes_F), sum(out_F$res$adj_pval < 0.05)))
cat(sprintf("male   : thresh %.2e -> %d genes (BH<0.05: %d)\n",
            cal_M$thresh, length(genes_M), sum(out_M$res$adj_pval < 0.05)))
cat(sprintf("age*sex: thresh %.2e -> %d genes; %d survive dropping 12m\n",
            cal_int$thresh, length(genes_int), length(robust_int)))

write.csv(tab_F,   "omnibus_female.csv",      row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(tab_M,   "omnibus_male.csv",        row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(tab_int, "interaction_age_sex.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Genes differentially expressed anywhere along the neutrophil
# developmental trajectory, by age and/or sex.  3m vs 18m only.
#
# Null      : gene has a developmental profile, identical in all groups
# Alternative: that profile differs by age, by sex, or in shape
# ==============================================================

library(monocle3)
library(glmGamPoi)
library(splines)
library(SingleCellExperiment)

set.seed(42)

## ---- column names in colData(combined_cds) -------------------
AGE_COL   <- "age"
SEX_COL   <- "sex"
STAGE_COL <- "stage"      # set to NA if you have no stage labels
PT_DF     <- 3            # spline df for pseudotime
NPERM     <- 20           # start here; raise once thresholds look stable
TARGET    <- 0.05         # empirical FDR
MIN_CELLS <- 10           # gene detected in >= this many cells


# ==============================================================
# 1. Extract and clean
# ==============================================================
cd$age <- factor(as.character(cd[[AGE_COL]]), levels = c("3m", "12m", "18m"))
cd$sex <- factor(as.character(cd[[SEX_COL]]), levels = c("female", "male"))

# anything that failed to map is now NA — catch it here, loudly
if (anyNA(cd$age) || anyNA(cd$sex)) {
  cat("unmapped labels:\n")
  print(table(as.character(cd[[AGE_COL]])[is.na(cd$age)], useNA = "ifany"))
  print(table(as.character(cd[[SEX_COL]])[is.na(cd$sex)], useNA = "ifany"))
}

keep_cells <- is.finite(cd$pt) & !is.na(cd$age) & !is.na(cd$sex) &
              cd$age != "12m"
cds <- cds[, keep_cells]
cd  <- droplevels(cd[keep_cells, ])
cd$age <- droplevels(cd$age)   # drops the now-empty 12m level
cd$grp <- droplevels(interaction(cd$age, cd$sex, sep = "_"))

stopifnot(!anyNA(model.frame(f_lean, cd, na.action = na.pass)))


# ==============================================================
# 2. Restrict to the pseudotime span covered by ALL four groups
#
# Group-specific splines extrapolate freely outside their own
# cell range, and that divergence reads as a real difference.
# ==============================================================
rng <- tapply(cd$pt, cd$grp, range)
lo  <- max(vapply(rng, `[`, numeric(1), 1))
hi  <- min(vapply(rng, `[`, numeric(1), 2))
cat(sprintf("\nshared pseudotime span: %.3f - %.3f (full: %.3f - %.3f)\n",
            lo, hi, min(cd$pt), max(cd$pt)))

# density across the span, per group -- look for empty/near-empty cells
brk <- quantile(cd$pt, 0:5 / 5)
cat("\n== cells per pseudotime quintile x group (BEFORE trimming) ==\n")
print(table(cut(cd$pt, brk, include.lowest = TRUE), cd$grp))

in_span <- cd$pt >= lo & cd$pt <= hi
cat(sprintf("\ntrimming removes %d of %d cells (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(!in_span), length(in_span), 100 * mean(!in_span)))
if (!is.na(STAGE_COL) && STAGE_COL %in% colnames(cd)) {
  cat("stages lost to trimming:\n")
  print(table(cd[[STAGE_COL]][!in_span]))
}

cds <- cds[, in_span]
cd  <- droplevels(cd[in_span, ])

cat("\n== final ==\n"); print(table(cd$sex, cd$age))
if (!is.na(STAGE_COL) && STAGE_COL %in% colnames(cd))
  print(table(cd[[STAGE_COL]], cd$grp))


# ==============================================================
# 3. Global gene filter -- defined once, on all cells
# ==============================================================
cts <- counts(cds)
cts <- cts[rowSums(cts > 0) >= MIN_CELLS, ]
cat(sprintf("\n%d genes x %d cells\n", nrow(cts), ncol(cts)))


# ==============================================================
# 4. Fit helper
# ==============================================================
run_lrt <- function(cts, md, full, reduced) {
  fit <- glm_gp(cts, design = full, col_data = md,
                size_factors = "normed_sum", on_disk = FALSE)
  list(fit = fit, res = test_de(fit, reduced_design = reduced))
}


# ==============================================================
# 5. Models
#
# LEAN is primary.  It lets both the age effect and the sex effect
# vary along pseudotime -- the "anywhere along the trajectory"
# part -- but omits the pt:age:sex term, which costs 3 df and is
# the worst-estimated piece of the model.
# FULL adds that three-way term; compare hit counts to see whether
# it earns its degrees of freedom.
# ==============================================================
f_lean <- ~ ns(pt, PT_DF) + age * sex +
            ns(pt, PT_DF):age + ns(pt, PT_DF):sex
f_full <- ~ ns(pt, PT_DF) * age * sex
f_null <- ~ ns(pt, PT_DF)                       # developmental profile only

# marginal decomposition: what remains when one factor is allowed
# to act freely in the reduced model
f_no_age <- ~ ns(pt, PT_DF) * sex               # -> tests any age effect
f_no_sex <- ~ ns(pt, PT_DF) * age               # -> tests any sex effect

out_any  <- run_lrt(cts, cd, f_lean, f_null)      # PRIMARY
out_full <- run_lrt(cts, cd, f_full, f_null)      # with three-way
out_age  <- run_lrt(cts, cd, f_full, f_no_age)    # age, marginal over sex
out_sex  <- run_lrt(cts, cd, f_full, f_no_sex)    # sex, marginal over age

cat("\ndf spent -- any:", out_any$res$df1[1],
    " full:", out_full$res$df1[1],
    " age:",  out_age$res$df1[1],
    " sex:",  out_sex$res$df1[1], "\n")


# ==============================================================
# 6. Permutation calibration
#
# Null = no dependence on age or sex, so age and sex are shuffled
# TOGETHER (keeping the pair intact) and pseudotime stays fixed.
# This preserves each cell's developmental position and library
# depth while destroying the group labels.
# ==============================================================
shuf_both <- function(md) {
  i <- sample(nrow(md)); md$age <- md$age[i]; md$sex <- md$sex[i]; md
}

perm_null <- function(cts, md, full, reduced, nperm = NPERM) {
  unlist(lapply(seq_len(nperm), function(i) {
    cat("."); if (i %% 10 == 0) cat(i, "\n")
    run_lrt(cts, shuf_both(md), full, reduced)$res$pval
  }))
}

cat("\npermuting (", NPERM, " x 4 fits, expect this to be slow)\n")
null_any <- perm_null(cts, cd, f_lean, f_null)
null_age <- perm_null(cts, cd, f_full, f_no_age)
null_sex <- perm_null(cts, cd, f_full, f_no_sex)

calib <- function(obs_p, null_p, target = TARGET) {
  grid <- 10^seq(-10, log10(0.05), length.out = 300)
  fdr  <- vapply(grid, function(c)
            (mean(null_p < c) * length(obs_p)) / max(1, sum(obs_p < c)),
            numeric(1))
  ok <- which(fdr <= target)
  if (!length(ok)) return(list(thresh = 0, fdr = NA_real_))
  i <- max(ok); list(thresh = grid[i], fdr = fdr[i])
}

cal_any <- calib(out_any$res$pval, null_any)
cal_age <- calib(out_age$res$pval, null_age)
cal_sex <- calib(out_sex$res$pval, null_sex)


# ==============================================================
# 7. Assemble and label
# ==============================================================
hits <- function(out, cal) out$res$name[out$res$pval < cal$thresh]

g_any <- hits(out_any, cal_any)
g_age <- hits(out_age, cal_age)
g_sex <- hits(out_sex, cal_sex)

tab <- out_any$res[out_any$res$name %in% g_any,
                   c("name", "pval", "adj_pval", "f_statistic")]
tab <- tab[order(tab$pval), ]
tab$age_effect <- tab$name %in% g_age
tab$sex_effect <- tab$name %in% g_sex
tab$driver <- with(tab, ifelse(age_effect & sex_effect, "both",
                        ifelse(age_effect, "age",
                        ifelse(sex_effect, "sex", "joint_only"))))

# where along the trajectory does each hit differ?  fitted values
# per group at five points across the span, for characterisation
pt_grid <- seq(min(cd$pt), max(cd$pt), length.out = 5)
newdat  <- expand.grid(pt = pt_grid, age = levels(cd$age), sex = levels(cd$sex))
mm      <- model.matrix(f_lean, newdat)
pred    <- out_any$fit$Beta[tab$name, , drop = FALSE] %*% t(mm)
colnames(pred) <- with(newdat, paste0("pt", round(pt, 2), "_", age, "_", sex))


# ==============================================================
# 8. Report
# ==============================================================
cat(sprintf("\nany age/or sex effect : thresh %.2e -> %d genes (BH<0.05: %d)\n",
            cal_any$thresh, length(g_any), sum(out_any$res$adj_pval < 0.05)))
cat(sprintf("  age-driven : %d\n  sex-driven : %d\n  both       : %d\n  joint only : %d\n",
            sum(tab$driver == "age"), sum(tab$driver == "sex"),
            sum(tab$driver == "both"), sum(tab$driver == "joint_only")))
cat(sprintf("\nthree-way model returns %d genes at BH<0.05 vs %d for lean\n",
            sum(out_full$res$adj_pval < 0.05), sum(out_any$res$adj_pval < 0.05)))

# does this recover the mature-compartment result, and what is new?
if (exists("genes_F")) {
  cat("\noverlap with the 56 mature-only female hits:",
      length(intersect(g_any, genes_F)), "\n")
  cat("trajectory-only (NOT in the mature analysis):",
      length(setdiff(g_any, genes_F)), "\n")
}

isg <- c("Isg15","Ifi27l2a","Oas1a","Oas1g","Oas3","Oasl2",
         "Slfn3","Slfn4","Ifitm3","H2-T24")
cat("\nISG module recovered:", paste(intersect(g_any, isg), collapse = ", "), "\n")

write.csv(tab, "pt_age_sex_hits.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(as.data.frame(pred), "pt_age_sex_fitted.csv")
saveRDS(list(any = out_any, full = out_full, age = out_age, sex = out_sex,
             cal = list(any = cal_any, age = cal_age, sex = cal_sex),
             cd = cd),
        "pt_age_sex_fits.rds")
```

```{r}
library(tradeSeq)

age_num <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", as.character(neus_all$age)))
pseudotime <- matrix(age_num, ncol = 1)
cellWeights <- matrix(1, nrow = ncol(mat_neus), ncol = 1)

sce <- fitGAM(
  counts      = as.matrix(counts),
  pseudotime  = pseudotime,
  cellWeights = cellWeights,
  conditions  = factor(neus_all$sex),   # this is the part that matters
  nknots      = 3
)

saveRDS(sce, "timecourse_all_mat_immat_GAM_model.rds")

assoRes <- associationTest(sce)
head(assoRes)
assoRes <- assoRes %>% na.omit() %>% subset(pvalue < 0.05)

startRes <- startVsEndTest(sce)
startRes <- startRes %>% na.omit() %>% subset(pvalue < 0.05)

res <- conditionTest(sce, l2fc = 0)
res$padj <- p.adjust(res$pvalue, "fdr")
res <- res %>% na.omit() %>% subset(padj < 0.05)

asso_per_sex  <- associationTest(sce, lineages = TRUE)
start_per_sex <- startVsEndTest(sce, lineages = TRUE)

endRes <- diffEndTest(sce)

add_fdr <- function(x) {
  x$padj <- p.adjust(x$pvalue, "fdr")
  x
}
asso_full <- add_fdr(na.omit(associationTest(sce, lineages = TRUE)))
asso_sig  <- subset(asso_full, padj < 0.05)
```
